Messages.Author: Emile Bosman
Messages.Body:
Our Prince said that the action you can take with the Madness Network
are considered an extension of your Minion phase.

Does this mean I can't use rotschrek for out of turn rush?

Emile

Messages.Author: tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
"Emile Bosman" <ebo...@hotmail.com> ha scritto nel messaggio
news:cbf416fb.0203...@posting.google.com...

> Our Prince said that the action you can take with the Madness Network
> are considered an extension of your Minion phase.
>
> Does this mean I can't use rotschrek for out of turn rush?
>

No, you can use the rotschrek when is not your turn, that is, say,
when one of your malks takes an action outside your turn (by the MN being in
play).
Never heard about this "minion extension phase", MN just allows
malkavians to take action outside their controller's minion phase
(and after the acting Met has finished with his/her minion phase), that's
all.

Ciao

Emiliano, vekn prince of Rome

Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
While we are on the subject of Madness Network...

Say I have a MN in play, and four untapped minions. At the end of my
Prey 's turn I start acting with my minions and the first one plays
Psychic Veil, giving everyone +1 stealth on their actions.

However, PV lasts until the end of "my turn" (per card text). Which
"turn" in this instance? The turn while I act via MN (my prey's turn,
or any other Meth's), or my next real turn? This is important if, say,
Masika pretends to be a Malk and untaps between each Meth's turn,
hence he could act every Meth's turn at +1 stealth...

Frederic.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Psychic Veil: "this turn", not "your turn", according to online card
text. That changed in the 1995 printing, I guess.
